Proposed slots (all PT):
- Thu Apr 22, 10:00–11:15
- Fri Apr 23, 09:00–10:15
- Fri Apr 23, 13:00–14:15

- 10m: Introductions + scope
- 25–30m: Live benchmark run (prefilled prompt set)
- 15–20m: Results readout + traces

Attached: finco_benchmark_scope.pdf — outlines model variant, sequence lengths, and data handling notes. Can you confirm which slot works best and whether Sara from security and procurement can join? If none of these work, please suggest three alternatives and we'll adapt.

Quick operational notes for security (Sara) — the demo will run from our hosted cluster. We will:
- Use only synthetic inputs (we've redacted all customer data in the harness)
- Limit telemetry to anonymized token-level latency traces (no request bodies)
- Provide an audit log extract post-run

Ethan — can you confirm the test harness runtime requirements (GPU type, expected sequence lengths, and KV cache sizing) so FinCo's engs know what to expect visually in the readout?

If procurement wants to review terms earlier, Karthik is happy to run a brief procurement-only session.

Checklist (for the live run):
- Host: Redwood hosted cluster (A100s; autoscale to 2 GPUs for the run)
- Input: synthetic prompt set (provided in runbook)
- Expected sequence lengths: 32–512 tokens; we will run a 3-step sweep across 32/128/512
- KV cache sizing: allow 8GB per model shard for the run (we will present KV hit/miss counts)
- Network: no inbound connections required from FinCo; all traffic initiates from Redwood

Notes: attaching the CSV so you can see rough latency percentiles across lengths. This is preliminary and representative only.

—Ethan
